thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: model-warmup failures detected in us-west-2 (zone a,b). Symptoms: repeated OOM during model load, container restarts, compile-timeout spikes. Paging oncall @sylvia :pager:
sylvia: on it. brief status?
ryan: i'm seeing a lot of OOMKilled on pods in model-loader deployment. Also some deserialization errors just before the crash.
ryan: sample kube events:
```
Warning  OOMKilled  3m (x12 over 10m)  kubelet  Container "model-loader" was OOMKilled
Error    Failed    2m (x6 over 7m)   kubelet  model artifact deserialize: EOF while reading header
```
priya: stack traces from the runtime show cuda driver resets on some nodes, and compile timeouts on rocm kernels (we've got mixed hw in the pool).
jamal: customer impact: two high-traffic tenants saw 5-10% 5xx for short windows, support already has a ticket for Tenant-Alpha.
eli: support-bot, confirm which customers got alerts?
support-bot: Tenant-Alpha and Beta had elevated error rates between 14:02-14:09 UTC, auto-fallback to smaller model succeeded for Beta, Alpha still saw some latency spikes.
sylvia: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable concurrent warmup for the model group in us-west-2 2) pin requests to fallback quantized model for known heavy tenants 3) cordon/evacuate nodes showing cuda resets 4) notify customers in-progress. any objections?
ryan: +1. I'll push a hotfix to the warmup controller: set max_concurrent_warmups=1 for the model namespace.
priya: i'll probe node logs, suspect bad driver version here. nodes: i-0a1b2c3d4e and i-0f9e8d7c6b. recommend drain of i-0a1b... now.
jamal: Eli, please prepare the customer message template for Alpha (short, apologetic, mitigation steps, ETA).
eli: drafting now, will post to the ticket and send an incident update to Alpha's CSM.
sylvia: executing the warmup controller change now:
```bash
kubectl -n models patch config warmup-controller -p '{"spec":{"max_concurrent_warmups":1}}'
```
ryan: warmup controller update applied. rolling restart of warmup pods in progress.
priya: draining node i-0a1b2c3d4e:
```bash
kubectl drain i-0a1b2c3d4e --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
priya: node drain succeeded, CUDA resets stopped on that node. switching traffic away from node.
jamal: metrics look better — model load error rate down 70% in the last 3m. latency for Alpha still elevated but trending down.
eli: customer message ready, posting now to ticket and CSM.
sylvia: next: we need a triage checklist for root cause: a) artifact corrupted during upload? b) driver/kernel mismatch causing deserialization to fail c) memory config too low for that model build (was recently bumped). Priya, Ryan please split those.
ryan: i captured the loader logs and artifact checksum mismatch for one model shard: some shards failed sha256 verification right before deserialize error. saving to /tmp/artifact-checksums-4290001234.log
priya: i confirm driver mismatch on one node (old driver still installed). ops will patch to recommended driver.
jamal: does this justify a rollback of the recent model build? it was deployed 2 hours before incident.
sylvia: hold on rollback until we confirm artifact integrity. if checksum fails for more shards we'll roll back. for now keep the quantized fallback pinned.
eli: updated customers: Alpha notified, Beta notified. no escalations yet.
ryan: found a compile timeout correlated with long p95 seq lengths during warmup; controller was trying to JIT compile kernels concurrently which pushed memory over limits. patch suggested: add exponential backoff + per-warmup mem cap.
sylvia: good. can we get a short-lived mitigation queued in next 10m? we should also add a fallback policy in routing to automatically pick precompiled model variants when compile-timeout > threshold.
priya: ops rolling driver update across the remaining nodes now. ETA 15m.
jamal: monitoring: deploying a temporary alert rule to catch OOMKilled spikes and driver reset counts, set severity to page if >5 pods in 5m.
eli: customer Alpha replied, appreciates the update, requested an RCA. we'll prepare post-incident.
sylvia: handing off to night oncall @ryan in 20m. Ryan you'll be primary; Priya you'll be secondary. leave this thread open for any late flares.
ryan: ack, taking over. i'll continue artifact verification and coordinate rollback if checksums fail.
priya: ack, i will finish driver rollout and report back.
jamal: leaving notes for RCA: potential CL 4321 (model build process) to audit artifact uploads, warmup controller concurrency bug, and node driver drift.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4213 status: mitigated -> partial, customer-impact ongoing (Alpha). oncall: ryan.
sylvia: thanks everyone. i'll draft incident summary and timeline for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
